hints.content:
The inequality $5<x$  is read as $5$ is less than $x$.  

So, $x$ must be greater than $5$.
So, we need to graph all values that are greater than $5$.

options.alt: A number line from negative 3 to 7 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at 5. A line running to the right starts at 5 and continues.

question.content:
